verdict.rationale: Stable's own API documents searching for and retrieving MailItems. Each MailItem carries scanDetails with an imageUrl and OCR result URLs, so scans and mail metadata can be pulled off the platform programmatically. However, no bulk export feature, archive download or PDF bundle is documented, so the operator would have to script retrieval through the API. missing for 10: a documented bulk/one-click export of mail history, explicit PDF export format, export of full history at account closure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do
